contract: Persistent local platform account assignments reference authoritative AppConfig agent profiles and existing social registrations. Requested/active/paused/revoked lifecycle enforces current revisions, single active owner, dependency readiness and durable reason history. Existing approval and credential authority remain unchanged.
acceptance: Real AppConfig profiles and registered social-account references, strict rejection of unknown identities
Idempotent request and optimistic transition provenance; terminal revoke and single active owner
Agent removal/account changes invalidate current readiness without losing audit records
Actual native/HTTP/Console lifecycle journeys and current-home isolation
limits: Local assignment metadata does not grant tool permission, provision external accounts, perform external registration/posting or revoke external credentials.
Shared native-tool, route and Page mounts are retained as integration evidence and excluded from owned-file accounting because adjacent communications slices extend them.
acceptance_coverage: Assignments bind real AppConfig agent IDs to current active canonical social-account revisions and reject missing agents/accounts or malformed shapes atomically.
Idempotent requests, optimistic transitions, immutable reason history, terminal revoke and the database-enforced single-active-owner rule persist across reopen.
Missing configured agents and changed, archived or removed social registrations make readiness false while preserving assignment and history records.
Approval-gated native tools, actual HTTP handlers and the current console execute request, activate, pause, reactivation, history, conflict and local revoke journeys in isolated homes.
